title: Take Weight Loss Meds Thursday Evening
hook: Here's why Thursday evening is the best time to inject Zepbound.
body:
The medication is strongest in the first few days after your shot, and it fades towards the end of the week. For me, and for basically every guy I've talked to about this, the days that need the most help are the weekend. Friday night, Saturday, Sunday: that is where diets go to die. The dinner out, the drinks, the pizza with the family, the afternoon when you eat out of boredom. If you inject Thursday evening, your appetite suppression is at maximum strength Friday night through Sunday. If you inject on a Monday, you're spending your strongest days on the days you're going to win anyway.

Not medical advice. Talk to your doctor.
close: Leave a comment to let me know what day you take your shot and if you're going to switch to Thursday.
